title: Homogeneous vectors have shifted homogeneous basis coordinates
statement: Let k be a field, S=k[x₀,x₁] with its total-degree grading, and M an S-module with an internal additive grading M_j indexed by integers, satisfying S_n M_j ⊆ M_(n+j). Let b_a (a∈Fin r) be an S-basis and d_a integers with b_a∈M_(-d_a). For every integer j and y∈M_j, the a-coordinate b.equivFun(y)(a) is homogeneous of polynomial degree d_a+j if this integer is nonnegative; otherwise it is zero. The assertion includes r=0.

source.document: Stacks Project; coordinate and chart argument of lem-sc-p1-homogeneous-basis-proj-coproduct
source.place: Constructions, Tags 01M6, 01M7 and 01MN; Sheaves on Spaces, Tag 009U

proof.text: Choose the additive decomposition of M provided by internality. Its projection P_z sends a degree-n homogeneous coefficient times b_i to that term when n-d_i=z, and to zero otherwise, by decompose_of_mem_same/ne and scalar compatibility.

Expand y by Basis.sum_equivFun, and expand each coordinate by sum_homogeneousComponent. Additivity of P_z gives the finite double sum with the preceding conditional formula. Apply Basis.equivFun, using equivFun_self to retain only the selected basis coordinate.

For y∈M_j, P_j(y)=y. Apply homogeneousComponent n to the coordinate identity. Every component with n-d_a≠j vanishes. If d_a+j≥0, comparison of monomial coefficients identifies the coordinate with homogeneousComponent (d_a+j).toNat, hence it is homogeneous. If d_a+j<0, every nonnegative component vanishes, so the coordinate is zero.

lean.statement:
theorem homogeneous_basis_coordinates (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))
    (𝓜 : ℤ → AddSubgroup M) (h𝓜 : DirectSum.IsInternal 𝓜)
    (hsmul : ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : ℤ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (y : M),
      a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n → y ∈ 𝓜 z → a • y ∈ 𝓜 (n + z))
    (r : ℕ) (d : Fin r → ℤ)
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin r) (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) M)
    (hb : ∀ a : Fin r, b a ∈ 𝓜 (-(d a)))
    (j : ℤ) (y : M) (hy : y ∈ 𝓜 j) :
    ∀ a, if 0 ≤ d a + j then
      b.equivFun y a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k (d a + j).toNat
    else b.equivFun y a = 0
